entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Tunku Dato' Seri Utama Naquiyuddin ibni Almarhum Tuanku Ja'afar is a member of Negeri Sembilan royal family who is the Tunku Laxamana. He is the eldest son of Tuanku Jaafar ibni Almarhum Tuanku Abdul Rahman, the tenth Yang di-Pertuan Besar of Negeri Sembilan, who was also the tenth Yang di-Pertuan Agong. He served as the Regent of Negeri Sembilan from 1994 to 1999 when his father was elected as the King of Malaysia.
